channel.title: The Garden Island - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Garden Island (thegardenisland.com)

item.title: Public urged to practice fireworks safety on Lunar New Year
item.description: LIHUE — The Kauai Fire Department strongly urges residents to prioritize fireworks safety on Feb. 17, the Lunar New Year.

item.title: Uproar over Sylvia Luke forces Green to cancel out-of-state trip
item.description: Lt. Gov. Sylvia Luke will not serve as acting governor this month after Gov. Josh Green announced Thursday that he has canceled his scheduled trip to Washington, D.C., to attend the National Governors Association meeting, as questions swirl over whether Luke is the focus of a state investigation.

item.title: Native Hawaiian help available on Monday
item.description: LIHUE — The Hawaiian Council will be on Kauai Monday to continue its statewide effort to help Native Hawaiian beneficiaries applying for the Office of Hawaiian Affairs (OHA) Emergency Relief Fund.

item.title: Kupuna enjoy Valentine’s Dance
item.description: Melanie Okamoto of the county’s Department of Parks and Recreation said Friday was the first time Na Kupuna Council used the Koloa Landing Resort as the site for the annual Senior Valentine’s Dance.

item.title: Puhi boy Jerik Centeno releases album
item.description: Jerik Centeno, a 2013 alumnus of Kauai High School and currently a Los Angeles-based film composer, producer and mix engineer, released his musical score for the film “Riley” on Friday.

item.title: Hawaii looks to fend off federal fossil fuels lawsuit
item.description: A lawsuit the federal government filed against Michigan over fossil fuels has been thrown out — prompting Hawaii to use that case to bolster its own of efforts to hold private companies accountable for their role in climate change.

item.title: TSA workers brace for another shutdown
item.description: When the Department of Homeland Security ran out of funding early Saturday, employees at the Transportation Security Administration assumed an unfortunately familiar role: the face of the latest impasse in Congress.

item.title: Road closures for the week of February 14–20
item.description: LIHUE — A number of road-related projects are on tap in the days ahead with grass cutting, tree trimming and guardrail repair making up the bulk of the work, the Hawaii Department of Transportation said in an update on Friday.

item.title: Will the Spirit of 1976 come to 2026?
item.description: Garland Pollard was 11 in 1976, the year the United States celebrated its 200th birthday, and was living in Virginia Beach with his parents.

item.title: Presidents’ Day notice to our readers
item.description: LIHUE — The Monday, Feb. 16, edition of The Garden Island will not be delivered via mail because the U.S. Postal Service will be closed in observance of the Presidents’ Day holiday.
